# NexusWX Telemetry & Weather Intelligence Station
> https://weather.techfliq.com/

NexusWX is a professional real-time meteorological telemetry web application providing multi-model weather forecasts, live satellite radar, flood risk advisories, air quality metrics, and regional weather news.

## Key System Features
- **Multi-Model Consensus Forecasting**: Compares 4 global weather models (ECMWF HRES, GFS, JMA, ICON) for temperature, wind speed, and precipitation consensus.
- **Smart Rain & Downpour Predictor**: Differentiates between rain cloud probability (%) vs actual hourly precipitation rate (mm/h).
- **Meteorological Hazard Advisories**: Automated real-time alerts for Extreme Heat, UV Index danger, Urban Waterlogging, Flash Floods, and High Wind gusts.
- **Live Satellite Radar Station**: Interactive Windy & RainViewer radar overlays with timestamp animation controls.
- **Sun & Moon Trajectory Tracker**: 180° parabolic solar elevation curve with daylight completion percentage and automatic night-time moon phase tracking.
- **Hierarchical Regional News Hub**: 3-tier location fallback (Village -> District -> State) parsing verified news dispatches while excluding weather aggregators.

## Technical Architecture
- **Framework**: Vite + React 18
- **Primary APIs**: Open-Meteo Weather API, RainViewer Radar API, Open-Meteo Air Quality API, Google News RSS
- **Canonical Domain**: https://weather.techfliq.com/
- **Google Analytics GA4 ID**: G-XVZLRQ016M
- **Publisher & Maintainer**: Techfliq (https://techfliq.com)
